Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: Merry Good Enough
programme.desc: Lucy Raulie has always had a complicated relationship with her family, but when her mother disappears on Christmas Eve, the dysfunctional family hit a new all-time low. Aided by her reluctant siblings in an attempt to bring the family back together, the Raulie kids may get more than they bargained for when their eccentric father, George, also shows up to "help" in the search for their wayward mom. A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

programme.title: Mara
programme.desc: A twisted, spine-tingling horror based on the ancient legend of the night hag demon - Mara. Criminal psychologist Kate (Olga Kurylenko: Quantum of Solace) is assigned to the murder of a man who has seemingly been strangled in his sleep by his wife and the only witness is their daughter. As Kate investigates she experiences the same petrifying symptoms and spirals through a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Romulus v. Remus: The First King
programme.desc: Vikings meets Game of Thrones meets Apocolypto, this historical action epic is the legendary story of two brothers who battled to found the greatest empire history has ever known Rome. With stunning visuals and immersive epic battle scenes, follow Romulus and Remus as they escape captivity, battle sacred fire and violent warriors, leading one of them seal his fate as the chosen one.

programme.title: Rise of the Krays
programme.desc: The early years of the two of the most notorious British criminals are portrayed in visceral brutality. London, 1961: Ronnie and Reggie Kray begin a reign of terror that would define London's East End for years to come. From protection rackets to members' clubs, street brawls to arson via blackmail extending all the way up to the Cabinet Office, the Krays rained red on anyone who crossed them.

programme.title: Arbitrage
programme.desc: When we first meet New York hedge fund magnate Robert Miller (Richard Gere), he appears the very portrait of success in American business and family life.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Fall
programme.desc: When her husband Samuel is mysteriously found dead in the snow below their secluded chalet, Sandra becomes the main suspect when the police begin to question whether he fell or was pushed.

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: Tennessee Williams' The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
programme.desc: After moving to Rome, a lonely widow finds herself consumed by a destructive love for a young Italian man in this adaptation of Tennessee Williams' haunting novella.

programme.title: Accidental Love
programme.desc: A small town waitress gets a nail accidentally lodged in her head causing unpredictable behavior that leads her to Washington, D.C., where sparks fly when she meets a clueless young senator who takes up her cause - but what happens when love interferes with what you stand for?

programme.title: If You Were the Last
programme.desc: Three years into a NASA mission that has gone very wrong, astronauts Adam (Anthony Mackie) and Jane (Zoe Chao) are stuck adrift between Jupiter and Saturn in a broken-down space shuttle.

programme.title: Forever In My Heart
programme.desc: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: Unjustly fired by a spoilt and selfish yacht owner, Kate gets payback when he falls overboard and wakes up with amnesia...

programme.title: A Good Woman
programme.desc: The seductive Mrs. Erlynne (Helen Hunt) travels to Amalfi, Italy, hoping to win over married aristocrat Robert Windermere. But when Windermere's innocent wife Meg (Scarlett Johansson) hears of the scandal, she plots an elaborate revenge.

programme.title: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Starring Mayim Bialik and Ryan McPartlin. Two strangers offer to share the last remaining room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: A Candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: Ellie, a perfume maker, travels back home for Christmas and help her dad with the business. Little does she know, that Logan is staying with him. As Ellie's attempts to learn about her family, Logan helps her realize that fairy tales do indeed exist!

programme.title: Secret Lives of Second Wives
programme.desc: Lynn finds that marriage the second time around is far from idyllic when her husband's (Brian McNamara) ex-wife and children return to manipulate him.

programme.title: Sweet Home Carolina
programme.desc: Diane is a struggling single mom in LA. Just when things are at their worst, but she will have to live in small town USA for a year and take care of a dog for a year before the house is hers.

programme.title: A Horse Called Hope
programme.desc: A strong-willed but moody teenager Lizzy is sent to live on her grandmother's ranch after an incident at school gets her suspended. Although reticent at first, Lizzy finally starts to unwind with the help of a nameless pony whom she calls Hope. When Lizzy learns the unfortunate news that the ranch is about to be foreclosed she devises a plan that will not only save her grandmother's property but also help Hope in the process.

programme.title: Love by Accident
programme.desc: After breaking down on a road trip with her godmother, a woman enlists her mechanic to be her fake boyfriend, but soon their fake relationship isn't so fake after all.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance
programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn't meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen's "Emma."

programme.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
programme.desc: A wreathmaker slips on ice and injures her arm which puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy until a selfless neighbor steps up to keep her business afloat.

programme.title: Grumpy Cat's Worst Christmas Ever
programme.desc: Grumpy Cat, with 6m Facebook fans, stars in a Lifetime movie.

programme.title: Reindeer Games Homecoming
programme.desc: MacKenzie competes in "The Reindeer Games" keep her father's tradition alive.

programme.title: Delivering Christmas
programme.desc: Lonely mailman Tom likes single mom Lauren, unnoticed amid her holiday grief.

programme.title: Amber's Story
programme.desc: This is the true story of the kidnapping of Amber Hagerman and how her family came together to help other abducted children as a result of her tragedy which resulted in a new system to help find missing children - The Amber Alert.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori gets breast revision surgery and throws a party to raise awareness for breast health. Time for a Booby Bash!

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: Widowed doctor Jessica vacations in Fiji with her daughter and finds love with resort owner Will.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: A podcast host who is cynical about love meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller.

programme.title: Ex Next Door
programme.desc: A happy couple's life turns upside down when the husband's ex-girlfriend moves in next door.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians puts together a purposely horrible team so they'll lose and she can move the team. But when the plot is uncovered, they start winning just to spite her.

programme.title: Friends with Benefits
programme.desc: When two friends decide to try something new and take advantage of their mutual attraction without any emotional attachment, they soon realize romantic comedy stereotypes might exist for a reason.

programme.title: Major League: Back To The Minors
programme.desc: A pitcher is about to be put out to pasture when he is given the opportunity to manage a team.

programme.title: Guarding Tess
programme.desc: A beloved but cantankerous former First Lady engages in a battle of wills with her bodyguard.

programme.title: How It Ends
programme.desc: In this feel-good apocalyptic comedy, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) embarks on a hilarious journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before it all ends, running into an eclectic cast of characters along the way.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: An out of touch family man moves back home to a beautiful house on the outskirts of town, but there's one small problem... It's about to be hit by an asteroid.

programme.title: Aloha

programme.title: She's Funny That Way

programme.title: Black Knight

programme.title: Shotgun

Joined by a bounty hunter and a captivating half-breed woman, he ventures into Apache land, uncovering a deadly plot to arm the tribes with repeating rifles.

programme.title: Pawnee
programme.desc: Pale Arrow is a white man raised since a boy by the Pawnee Chief. With wagon trains now encroaching on Pawnee land, the Chief sends Pale Arrow to be with the white people.

programme.title: Mackenzie's Raiders EP17-20
programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Belle Starr's Daughter
programme.desc: The daughter of famous outlaw Belle Starr arrives at the town where her mother was murdered to find her killer.

programme.title: This Sporting Life
programme.desc: Richard Harris gives a great performance as a man who wants to quit his job as a miner.

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: David Balfour is an orphaned young man and the true heir to the title of Master of the Shaws.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: Tolstoy's tale of the ardent but doomed love between Anna and Vronsky.

programme.title: Sea Of Sand
programme.desc: The Long Range Desert Group are sent to destroy a German fuel dump.

programme.title: Last Knights
programme.desc: In an age of honour and justice by the sword, Raiden is a fallen warrior who must rise up against a corrupt and sadistic ruler to avenge Bartok, his dishonoured master.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter

programme.title: Meteor: First Impact

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Jungle By Night
programme.sub-title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals. Their December 2010 performance with former backing musicians of Afrobeat founder Fela Kuti in Paris saw them hailed as "the future of Afrobeat".

programme.title: Omer Avital
programme.sub-title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin. They present singular repertoire from Avital's album 'Qantar'.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Maya Oganyan, Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece's premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique' – this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work's stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger') by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Coldplay
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

Empieza una divertida misión con un solo objetivo: tener un hijo.

Se enfrentará frente a frente con un tiburón devora-hombres, vigilará a los Miami Dolphins y coqueteará con las chicas. Encubierto, abaleado o bajo el agua, siempre consigue a su hombre… o bestia.

programme.title: ¿Qué Pasó Anoche?

A pesar de los años transcurridos, su amor por él sigue intacto. Cuando quedó viuda estaba embarazada y dio luz a Miranda, convertida ya en una hermosa joven. Desde entonces, tuvo el apoyo incondicional de Philip, el mejor amigo de su marido, quien siempre ha estado enamorado de ella. Cuando Louie murió, en el cielo se le brindó la oportunidad de reencarnarse en Alex Finch, un apuesto joven. Al conocer a Miranda por casualidad, Alex/Louie entra de nuevo en la vida de Corinne, desbaratándola por completo.

programme.title: Step Brothers

programme.title: Allá en el bajio

programme.title: Se busca

programme.title: Las cenizas del diputado

programme.title: El Experimento del Terror

programme.title: El cobrador de deudas 2

programme.title: Druid Peak

programme.title: El pibe Cabeza
programme.desc: La vida de "El Pibe Cabeza", un auténtico gángster argentino de los años 30.

programme.title: La maldición 2

Tatsuya Suzuki, un agente de bienes raíces, le pide a su hija Kyouko que vaya a la casa en la que Kayako y Kobayashi fueron asesinados (y donde también se produjo la desaparición de la familia Murakami). Kyouko logra ver el fantasma de Kayako y esto le da motivo para iniciar su propia investigación sobre los hechos, llegando a la conclusión que Kayako fue muerta en la casa de Kobayashi. Tatsuya vende la casa encantada al matrimonio de los Kitada.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: 3 generaciones

Junto a su madre, Maggie (Naomi Watts), viven en casa de su abuela, Dolly (Susan Sarandon), una manager de música que comparte piso con su novia. Maggie tiene que enfrentarse al padre de Regan para que firme también los permisos de la operación y deberá asumir que tiene que criar a su única hija como un hijo.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una apartada urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que esconde algo extraño porque la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: En esta casa hay algo que permanece escondido. Su medio es la oscuridad. Y una nueva familia acaba de instalarse con un niño pequeño. Será la última jugada maestra de la oscuridad. Ya sólo hace falta mover las piezas. Y esperar.

programme.title: Amateurs

Vallecas (Madrid): Julio Nieves, un fornido capataz de la construcción de 65 años, cae desplomado en su ducha. A partir de ahora se enfrenta a su dura jubilación.

programme.title: La espina de Dios

programme.title: Family Covenant
programme.desc: A band goes into the woods looking for inspiration and get picked off one by one.

programme.title: The Devil And Leroy Bassett
programme.desc: Leroy Bassett and his dim-witted brothers go on the lam after freeing their friend Keema from jail.

programme.desc: Halfwit Indian Akaena promises a fictitious treasure to anyone who takes her down south where the sun always shines. Trapper Bill Robinson, an honest fur trader in Alaska, refuses to sell his dog sled to dishonest miner Mike Williams, who steals it at gunpoint.

programme.title: Julio César IL CONQUISTATORE DELLE GALLIE

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

El oficial Mike Chandler y un joven civil se ven envueltos en el robo de un banco a manos de unos hombres armados.

programme.title: Skin Trade: Tráfico humano

programme.title: Sharpshooter
programme.desc: Un asesino que trabaja para la CIA decide aceptar un último trabajo antes de retirarse, solo para descubrir que él es el objetivo de su propio jefe en la CIA.

programme.desc: 1363. La Muerte Negra ha aniquilado a la mitad de la población. Muchos huyen de la muerte y la miseria en busca de una vida mejor en otro lugar. Pero el campo está densamente poblado. Y, en las montañas, bandas de ladrones hacen de la vida algo efímero.

programme.title: En nombre del rey
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado Farmer se propone rescatar a su esposa secuestrada y vengar la muerte de su hijo.

programme.title: El Chicano
programme.desc: El detective Hernández se convierte en “El Chicano” para vengar a su hermano y salvar su ciudad.

programme.title: Tierra Marciana
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos deben averiguar cómo detener la tormenta de arena que se dirige hacia ellos.

programme.title: El último Sharknado Ya era hora

programme.title: Fight to the Finish
programme.desc: Un boxeador aficionado se gana un enemigo cuando se interpone entre su vecina de al lado y su ex maltratador.

programme.title: The Raid 2: Berandal
programme.desc: Poco después de finalizar la sangrienta redada, el inspector Rama se ve obligado a infiltrarse en las filas del sindicato del crimen de Yakarta con el fin de proteger a su familia y descubrir la corrupción en el seno de su propia fuerza policial.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood

La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Venganza
programme.desc: El mortífero virus T de la Corporación Umbrella se extiende por el planeta y transforma a gente común y corriente en legiones de muertos vivientes. La raza humana va camino a la extinción y tiene solo una esperanza: Alice (Milla Jovovich). Ella tiene la misión de abrirse paso por ciudades y a través de continentes, todo dentro de la instalación de investigación principal de Umbrella. Viejos amigos se convierten en nuevos enemigos mientras Alice lucha por escapar y descubre que todo lo que cree quizá no sea verdad.
